Sandbox_RebuildingKnoxDemo_ExperimentalW: Enables the whole-map scan prompt in Debug Mode. Requires AutomaticMapper. Press the Rebuilding Knox scan key to start; the scan can pause the game and create a large JSON file. Buildings, rooms, MetaGrid zones and navigation zones are included. Individual world tiles are only available while loaded by the game.
Sandbox_RebuildingKnoxDemo_SpawnWithRevo: Give the character one random available standard revolver when first created. The matching ammunition amount can be configured below.
Sandbox_RebuildingKnoxDemo_SpawnWithShel: Spawn with a Rebuilding Knox shelter kit
Give a writable notebook, hammer, 10 food items, 5 clothing items, and 3 lit hand torches so you can start converting the house you spawn in into a Rebuilding Knox refuge.
Sandbox_RebuildingKnoxDemo_SpawnRevolver: Number of loose rounds matching the selected revolver. Default: 400. Set to 0 for no ammunition.
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_InputDiagnostics_tool: Writes right-click events, interface hover, ADS state and Viewpoint capture state to console.txt. Disable after testing.
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_CrouchIronFocus: Experimental: Crouch enables Iron Sights FOV Change
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_CrouchIronFocus_toolt: While crouched and aiming through iron sights, narrow only the view FOV. Attached optics and saved weapon calibrations are unaffected.
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_CrouchIronFocusMultip: Multiplies the weapon's calibrated ADS FOV. Lower values zoom further; 1.00 disables the extra zoom. Default: 0.70.
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_WheelIronFocus_toolti: While aiming any weapon, scroll up to hold focus and down to release it. Focus takes 0.4 seconds to engage and, while stationary, reduces temporary sight movement by 70%%. Breath lasts 5 seconds plus 1 second per Fitness level, reduced by exertion. A translucent bar appears during focus. Trying to engage it before enough breath has recovered or the cooldown ends briefly shows a red X with "Espera...". After focus ends, breath starts recharging after 0.4 seconds at 0.25 seconds per real second, increased by 10%% per Fitness level; at least 25%% must recover before focus can start again. Sprinting drains 1 second of breath per real second, and normal running drains 0.5 seconds. Firing cancels focus.
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_FocusSearchBlur: Experimental: search-style blur during manual focus
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_FocusSearchBlur_toolt: Blurs the surroundings during manual focus with any weapon using Project Zomboid's search-mode visual effect. The effect ends when focus ends and does not turn on foraging or its icons. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_ExperimentalExtendedR: Experimental: increase all firearm ranges by 50 percent
Extends the effective MaxRange of all aimed firearms by 50 percent. Enabled by default during testing. Gael's dynamic ammo values remain intact. Requires a game restart.
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_NerfLongDistances_too: Only works when the experimental range increase is enabled. Hits beyond each weapon's original range deal 30 percent less damage to characters. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_HeadshotDamageBonus: Headshot bonus by caliber and weapon type (1–8+ tiles)
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_HeadshotDamageBonus_t: Damage keeps the caliber scale. The bonus range is weapon-class base +8 tiles per caliber tier, capped at 64: pistol/shotgun 8, submachine gun 16, rifle 24 and precision rifle 32 tiles before caliber steps. Disable this option to remove the damage and range bonuses. Unrecognized ammo keeps the previous +30% damage bonus. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_HeadshotImpactSound_t: Randomly plays one of three impact sounds at the zombie when the headshot damage bonus applies. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_NoReferenceHoldSway: ADS weapon sway by weight and length
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_NoReferenceHoldSway_t: Applies 0.4–0.8 degrees of temporary ADS yaw/pitch sway at Strength 5 to Gael firearms, based 70%% on game weight and 30%% on model or estimated length. Each Strength level changes sway by 10%%. Arm muscle stiffness at 5–19 adds 150%% sway; at 20 or more it adds 300%%, with irregular aim corrections up to 0.54 degrees. Endurance exertion adds 100%%, 150%%, or 200%% sway at levels 1, 2, and 3–4. Shots reset the sway to center; smooth realignment occurs every 3–5 seconds. Independent of sight motion and shot pitch recoil. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_SightMotion: Experimental: ADS sight X/Y/Z and walking Roll
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_SightMotion_tooltip: Temporarily moves sight X/Y/Z during endurance exertion. At exertion 3–4 the sight may dip in Z to -0.006. Walking adds smooth Y movement of 0.02–0.04 and progressive Roll up to ±3 degrees in 0.01-degree steps at twice the previous turning speed. Saved calibrations stay intact. Independent of angular sway and shot pitch recoil. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_ShotPitchRecoil_toolt: Shot recoil and the base Project Viewpoint ADS recoil are reduced by 40%% for Gael firearms. The listed angle ranges are before this reduction. Each aimed shot moves Pitch up/down and Yaw left/right; each axis chooses direction independently (50/50). Base Pitch magnitude: 2–5 degrees without exertion, 2–7 at level 1, 4–8 at level 2, 3–10 at levels 3–4. Base Yaw: 1–4, 1–6, 3–7, 2–9. Weapons weighing more than 2.2 add 5 degrees to both endpoints of both ranges. Pistols using .44, .45 or .50 add 3 degrees; .22 and .32 pistols add 1 degree. For all weapons, burst shots 1–3 use 50%% recoil, shots 4–5 use 75%%, and later shots use 100%%; only in Auto mode, shot 21 onward adds 3 degrees to both axes after other reductions, keeps their direction and adds a new random Pitch/Yaw impulse around the held position on each later shot. Each bullet advances part of a 4–5-shot path toward a random different corner, avoiding the previous corner; motion is smoothed between shots. Releasing the trigger after 26 or more Auto shots holds the recoil offset for 0.6 seconds, with an irregular circular regrip in the first 0.4 seconds, before it returns to center. A one-second pause, weapon change, or fire-mode change resets the count. In Auto fire mode, both angles also scale with Strength: 1/8 at level 0, 1/16 at level 5 and 1/24 at level 10. Arm muscle stiffness at 5–19 adds 150%% recoil; at 20 or more it adds 300%%. Ordinary recoil settles in 0.3–0.5 seconds, or 0.4–0.7 seconds for weapons heavier than 2.2; after shot 20 in Auto mode it settles over 1.15 seconds, shortened to 1.00 second from shot 27 onward. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_ShotRecoilAffectsAim: Apply new mod recoil to aim + ADS recoil
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_ShotRecoilAffectsAim_: The purple aim marker and shot direction follow the new mod recoil pitch and yaw in addition to Viewpoint ADS native recoil. Applies only to Gael firearms while aiming down sights; disabling keeps the usual shot direction. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_BoltPitchMotion: Experimental: Pitch movement while racking a firearm
Sandbox_PVADSGAEL2_BoltPitchMotion_toolt: While the game performs the firearm rack/bolt action, sight Pitch moves upward or downward with 50%% chance for either direction, by 2–4 degrees. A slight random Yaw movement accompanies it. Both motions return smoothly to their saved alignment 10–30%% before the action ends, with slightly varied timing. Follows the action regardless of the key bound to it. Enabled by default.
